items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "my son says, Hey, Pop, you know you can send it by pdf.”"

ctx.x: And it’s kind of nice if you’re in Europe or Asia or something and you don’t have a part or something …

Exactly. Well, I remember sending some--, when I used to write it by hand, I remember sending arrangements to Spain and they got lost in the mail. And I was writing the music at the computer. But my son says, Hey, Pop, you know you can send it by pdf.” I said, “PD What?” And he said, come here, you know. And he turned me onto--. And now most of the music programs you can write the score and the parts and then turn them into pdf and just email them, you know. And if anybody loses the part, I got another one here,…
You said something in your answer that made me think of this next question. Your book.
